node: Semiconductor manufacturing data, yield analytics, traceability, and orchestration software
summary: This pass expands the direct public-company universe around semiconductor manufacturing data orchestration. The cleanest underfollowed exposure is PDF Solutions, whose Exensio platform directly targets semiconductor manufacturing, test, assembly, packaging, yield, and traceability data. Onto Innovation is a less pure but still relevant mid/large-cap equipment-and-software company with factory analytics and yield-management software tied to metrology, inspection, lithography, and advanced packaging. Synopsys is included as a high-attention reference leader because Silicon Lifecycle Management links design, manufacturing, test, and in-field silicon data, but its overall company exposure is broad. Amkor is included as a direct customer/context anchor: an OSAT and advanced-packaging operator whose complexity, test volume, chiplet adoption, and unit-level traceability needs help validate the demand side for this node. No investment recommendation is made.
